decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm's GeoIT integration capabilities and with stronger standalone presentation by 2024, this service fits existing knowledge well and is likely to be improved rather than withdrawn.

The framework is closely related to the firm's core geospatial development competence, but its weaker market signalling on the website suggests some risk that it could be folded into broader service offerings instead of remaining a distinct product.

This identity and access service directly complements the firm's established GIS integration business, and the move from launch mention to a dedicated page indicates sufficient early traction and learning potential to continue.

A consulting workshop builds very directly on the firm's existing advisory, training and process-integration knowledge, so it is relatively easy to adapt and keep unless demand proves clearly too limited.
